top_signals.title: Indian Oil Subsidiary CPCL Plans 280,000 Bpd Manali Refinery
top_signals.summary: Indian refiner Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited plans to boost the crude oil refining capacity at its Manali refinery by a third to 280,000 barrels per day (bpd), the refiner said in its 2025/2026 report. Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) is a subsidiary of the country's top state-controlled refiner, Indian Oil Corporation. The refinery at Manali, Chennai, has facilities to produce fuels, lubricants, waxes, and petrochemicals.
